_comment: LOCKED winning ensemble for AISA-ArabicFC blind test (2026-07-20), Six members + enum-validity combiner. With both convention rules this scores ArgEM 0.822 / OverallA 0.8925 on dev under v1.4 gold, and 0.816 under v1.3 gold. Plain per-argument majority vote (no dev-tuned weights => generalizes) + enum-validity override (CV-confirmed, generalizes to blind). Tie-break order was fixed on an early gold revision and no longer tracks measured strength (qC is strongest); correcting it leaves dev ArgEM unchanged at 0.822.
